# Runs received but not finished

Where these methods are:

- `session.runs` — `Session.runs`, a `SessionRuns`

Every method here is generated from igni-core's RPC contract; its documentation is igni's own. The examples run inside an `async` function with `igni` an open `IgniClient` and `session` one of its sessions ([Quick start](/docs/sdk/igni-client/quick-start)).

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`session.runs.discard_interrupted()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/runs#session-runs-discard-interrupted) | Forget one interrupted run, so it is not offered again. |
| [`session.runs.interrupted()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/runs#session-runs-interrupted) | List a session's runs that stopped before they finished. |
| [`session.runs.pending_messages()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/runs#session-runs-pending-messages) | List a session's messages that were received but never answered. |

## session.runs.discard_interrupted()

Forget one interrupted run, so it is not offered again.

```python
async def discard_interrupted(self, message_id: str) -> DiscardInterruptedRunResult
```

`message_id` names the run (from `get_interrupted_runs`);
`session_id` the session it belongs to; only that session's
interrupted run is deleted. Returns `ok: true` — also when no such
run exists, so a retry is harmless — or `ok: false` with `error`
when `message_id` is empty or the store could not be written.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message_id` | `str` | required | `message_id` names the run (from `get_interrupted_runs`); |

**Returns** [`DiscardInterruptedRunResult`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models-reference#discardinterruptedrunresult).

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `discard_interrupted_run`, scope `session`, area `session`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
for run in await session.runs.interrupted():
    await session.runs.discard_interrupted(run.message_id)
```

## session.runs.interrupted()

List a session's runs that stopped before they finished.

```python
async def interrupted(self) -> list[InterruptedRun]
```

`session_id` names the session. Returns one row per run that was
cancelled or failed: the `message_id` and text of the message that
started it, when it arrived and when it stopped, why (`cancelled`
or `errored`) and the last error. A client offers to retry,
discard or edit each. A storage failure answers an empty list.

Takes no arguments (`session_id` is this session's own).

**Returns** `list[`[`InterruptedRun`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models-reference#interruptedrun)`]`.

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `get_interrupted_runs`, scope `session`, area `session`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
for interrupted_run in await session.runs.interrupted():
    print(interrupted_run.content, interrupted_run.interrupted_at)
```

## session.runs.pending_messages()

List a session's messages that were received but never answered.

```python
async def pending_messages(self) -> list[PendingMessage]
```

`session_id` names the session. Returns the user messages still
pending at least a minute after they arrived — typically left by a
crash — oldest first, each with its text, when it arrived and its
`message_id`. A storage failure answers an empty list.

Takes no arguments (`session_id` is this session's own).

**Returns** `list[`[`PendingMessage`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models-reference#pendingmessage)`]`.

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `get_pending_messages`, scope `session`, area `session`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
for pending_message in await session.runs.pending_messages():
    print(pending_message.role, pending_message.content)
```
